title: Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens
before: Open corpora existed but the pipelines that produced them were partly undocumented.
problem: Without the tooling and decisions, you cannot audit or rebuild a corpus.
breakthrough: Three trillion tokens released with the full curation toolkit and documented design decisions.
why: It made pretraining data auditable, which matters for bias, contamination and copyright questions.
next: OLMo trained on it; FineWeb pushed the open-data quality bar further.
inherits: Data provenance as a publishable artefact.
